ex_navy.name: Ex-Navy Officer
ex_navy.description: You learned gun drill and command on a King's ship. Crews respect your discipline; pirates distrust it.

merchant_son.name: Merchant's Son
merchant_son.description: Your father's money bought you a schooner and an education in ledgers. The sea will teach you the rest.

indentured.name: Escaped Indentured Servant
indentured.description: Seven years' labour on a planter's contract, until you ran. You own little but a stolen sloop and a grudge.

disgraced_privateer.name: Disgraced Privateer
disgraced_privateer.description: You sailed with a letter of marque until a prize went missing and the Admiralty blamed you. Crews know your name.
